title: GateSight: Recurrent Memory Anticipates Attention Memory for Query-Agnostic KV Eviction in Hybrid LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.14754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid language models interleave Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, whose recurrent memory has a fixed size, with full-attention layers, whose key-value (KV) cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. In this paper, we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. We first show that which GDN heads of Qwen3.8-27B keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. Next, we define the future utility of a KV entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations, and find that the write gate, decay and write magnitude that GDN layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. Because the relation is spread across many GDN heads and layers, and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one, we propose GateSight, which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer per

translated_title: GateSight：循环记忆预判注意力记忆，实现混合大语言模型中查询无关的KV驱逐
translated_abstract: 混合语言模型将门控DeltaNet（GDN）层与全注意力层交错排列，前者的循环记忆大小固定，后者的键值（KV）缓存随上下文增长并主导服务时的内存开销。本文探讨的核心问题是：循环记忆是否已经知道注意力记忆将来需要什么。我们首先证明，在Qwen3.8-27B中，哪些GDN头保留长记忆是由模型权重决定的，而非由具体文档决定。接着，我们通过移除某个KV条目后在模型自身续写上引起的注意力输出变化程度来定义该条目的“未来效用”，并发现GDN层在预填充阶段发出的写入门控、衰减和写入幅度，在任何查询被看到之前就能预测这一效用。由于这种关系分散在众多GDN头和层之中，且线性映射虽能恢复其总体趋势，但在恢复高效用尾部方面不如非线性映射，我们提出GateSight，使用轻量的逐头多层感知机来学习这种关系。
tldr: 该论文提出GateSight，发现混合LLM中GDN层在预填充阶段输出的门控信号能够在看到任何查询之前预判KV条目的未来效用，从而实现查询无关的高效KV缓存驱逐。
en_tdlr: GateSight shows that gate signals emitted by GDN recurrent layers during prefill anticipate the future utility of KV entries before any query is seen, enabling lightweight query-agnostic KV eviction in hybrid LLMs.
